_about: Net-class catalogue. Each entry defines per-class trace width, clearance, via geometry, and (for differential pairs) coupled-pair gap + width. Entries are written verbatim into `.kicad_pro -> net_settings.classes`. `assignment_patterns` is the regex-based net-name -> class mapping fed into `net_settings.netclass_patterns` so freshly imported nets snap to the right class without manual assignment.
_units: all in mm. KiCad stores ohms only on the diff-pair side via geometry — actual impedance depends on the chosen stackup_profile, NOT this file. Pair this with stackup_profiles.json when picking diff_pair_width / diff_pair_gap.

Default._comment: Everything not matched by a more specific pattern. Conservative width chosen so DEFAULT nets pass on every fab profile in fab_profiles.json without bumping into min_track_width.
Default.name: Default

POWER._comment: Positive supply rails (VCC / VDD / +3V3 / +5V / VBUS / VBAT etc). 0.508 mm = 20 mil — matches the 'Power Trace Width 20 mil or more' rule. @ 1 oz copper carries ~1.4 A at 10 degC rise (IPC-2152). Project can override per-rail for higher current.
POWER.name: POWER

GND._comment: Ground / return nets. Track width matches POWER (20 mil = 0.508 mm) because GND traces (in 2-layer designs without a pour) carry the full return current; in 4+ layer with a pour this width is effectively unused — the zone handles routing.
GND.name: GND

HIGH_SPEED._comment: Generic high-speed single-ended net (clock, fast control, RGMII single lines). Thinner trace and tighter spacing keep impedance reachable. Real Z0 target depends on stackup.
HIGH_SPEED.name: HIGH_SPEED

CLOCK._comment: Crystal lines, MCU clock outputs, oscillator nets. Narrow + isolated; needs ground guard or short routing. Treated separately from HIGH_SPEED because clock integrity is its own design problem.
CLOCK.name: CLOCK

DIFF_USB._comment: USB differential pair (D+/D-). 90 ohm Zdiff per USB 2.0 + 3.0 spec. Diff geometry assumes outer-layer microstrip on a 4-layer 1.6 mm FR4 stackup; recompute when stackup changes.
DIFF_USB.name: DIFF_USB

DIFF_ETH._comment: Ethernet differential pair (TX+/TX- and RX+/RX-) — 100 ohm Zdiff per 100BASE-TX. Same caveat as DIFF_USB: geometry tied to a specific stackup.
DIFF_ETH.name: DIFF_ETH

ANALOG._comment: Op-amp inputs, ADC refs, sensor lines. Wider than HIGH_SPEED to reduce thermal noise, kept away from digital aggressors.
ANALOG.name: ANALOG

assignment_patterns._comment: Regex-style net-name -> class assignment. Patterns are wildcard-style (KiCad's netclass_patterns syntax: '*' matches any sequence, '?' matches one char). Order matters — earlier patterns win. Add custom rules at the top, fall back to the broad catch-all rules below. Pure data — no Python list of net names in code.

preset_track_widths_mm._comment: Track-width presets dropped into .kicad_pro -> board.design_settings.track_widths. KiCad's PCB Editor shows these as quick-pick buttons. The leading 0.0 is the 'use net class width' sentinel KiCad expects.

preset_via_dimensions_mm._comment: Via-size presets dropped into .kicad_pro -> board.design_settings.via_dimensions. Pairs of (outer-diameter, drill).
